messages:
Anya: Heads-up — Sundial POC needs a realistic perf run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Customer wants a mixed workload: 800 sustained qps, 30m soak, 50% chat (ctx ~512 tokens), 50% embedding calls. SLA asks: chat p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms. Need run plan, config snippet we can hand ops, and a quick cost sketch. Also they require KMS integration for embeddings. Can @Mike / @Sanjay / @Lee advise?

Mike: We can run this. Recommendation: Dedicated pool for predictability (hosted burst will be noisy at p99). Need to pick model family (small-vs-large) — tradeoff latency vs quality. We'll enable prefix/KV caching for chat flows. Also: batching and token scheduling matter a lot for p99.

Sanjay: I can own the harness. Proposed run phases: 1) smoke (5m @50 qps) 2) ramp (15m up to 800 qps in steps) 3) soak (30m @800 qps). Capture p50/p95/p99, tail traces, and console traces for model and network. Will push metrics to the POC dashboard. Here's the load config I'll use:
```json
{"target_qps":800, "ramp_minutes":15, "soak_seconds":1800, "mix":[{"type":"chat","pct":50,"context_len":512},{"type":"embed","pct":50,"avg_tokens":16}], "checkpoints":["p50","p95","p99"]}
```

Lee: FYI on security: KMS calls for embedding key unwrap add ~5–12ms median depending on HSM. Remote HSMs can spike if they throttle; recommend caching wrapped key client-side for the run, or use our KMS-proxy to keep latency bounded. Also will need the customer to sign the security addendum for KMS access.

Kelsey: For costing: rough sketch before we lock model — 800 sustained mixed load typically maps to 3–5 GPU equivalents depending on model/quantization. If we recommend Dedicated reserved with 24/7 baseline + burst, I can run a detailed estimate once you pick model/quant. Put me on action to run numbers.

Mike: Ops notes/config to hit targets: enable batch_size=16 for chat token generation, token_batch_budget_ms=200, kv_cache_ttl=12h, enable prefix cache with eviction 10k entries. Fallback route: if we see queue depth > 200ms, route new requests to smaller quantized variant. Also set request timeout 30s and downstream retry=1.

Anya: Helpful. @Sanjay please schedule the harness for 09:00 PT tomorrow and tag results with "sundial-poc-1778000001". @Kelsey aim for a preliminary cost delta by EOD. @Lee can you draft the short KMS checklist we can send the customer? :thumbsup:

bench-bot: Run scheduled by Sanjay — id: br-1778000001, target start: 2026-05-10T16:00:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak.

Sanjay: Scheduled and harness checked in. I'll post the short results thread after soak with p50/p95/p99 and a few flamegraphs.

Kelsey: I'll drop the initial cost sketch here by 18:00 PT. For a quick placeholder: assume 4x A100-equivalent for steady-state -> ~ $X/hr (will confirm).

Mike: One more note — enable tracing hooks for the model runner and API gateway so we can correlate token times to infra spans. Saves a lot of time diagnosing p99.

Anya: Great — thanks team. I'll prep the customer note and include the KMS checklist once Lee posts it.
